```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Knit from reports/; everything below runs from the project root.
root <- normalizePath("..")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 4, fig.align = "center")
devtools::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Text and table values: "$" escaped so pandoc never reads a pair of them as maths.
usd  <- function(x) paste0("\\", scales::dollar(round(x)))
usdk <- function(x) paste0("\\", .usdk(x))
pct  <- function(x) paste0(round(100 * x), "%")
# Chart labels: plain "$".
.usdk <- function(x) ifelse(abs(x) >= 1e6, paste0("$", formatC(x / 1e6, format = "f", digits = 2), "M"),
                            paste0("$", round(x / 1e3), "K"))
axis_usd <- scales::label_dollar(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
            theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
                  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")))
```

```{r data}
# Same model as the HTML report.
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "FY28_churn_forecast_model.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
```

# FY28

**Can we hold churn to plan this year?** On the current pipeline the model gives a
**`r pct(fy[["Chance at or under plan"]])`** chance of finishing FY28 at or under the
**`r usd(plan_fy)`** company churn plan. Hitting plan is `r verdict(fy[["Chance at or under plan"]])`.

```{r fy-cards}
vs_plan <- function(x) ifelse(x > plan_fy, paste("+", usdk(x - plan_fy)), paste("−", usdk(plan_fy - x)))
cards <- data.frame(
  `Company plan`      = c(usdk(plan_fy), "FY28 churn, four quarters"),
  `Best case (P25)`   = c(usdk(fy$P25), paste(vs_plan(fy$P25), "vs plan")),
  `Most likely (P50)` = c(usdk(fy$P50), paste(vs_plan(fy$P50), "vs plan")),
  `Worst case (P75)`  = c(usdk(fy$P75), paste(vs_plan(fy$P75), "vs plan")),
  check.names = FALSE)
cards[1, ] <- paste0("**", cards[1, ], "**")
knitr::kable(cards, format = "pipe", align = "c")
```

**What the percentiles say.** Across `r format(params$n_sims, big.mark = ",")` simulated
years, FY28 churn comes in at `r usd(fy$P25)` in the best case (25th percentile),
`r usd(fy$P50)` most likely (50th percentile) and `r usd(fy$P75)` in the worst case
(75th percentile). The plan of `r usd(plan_fy)` sits at the
`r round(100 * fy[["Chance at or under plan"]])`th percentile of the distribution: in
`r pct(fy[["Chance at or under plan"]])` of simulated years churn stays at or under plan,
and in `r pct(1 - fy[["Chance at or under plan"]])` it overshoots.

**What's already locked in.** `r usd(certain_fy)` of FY28 churn is certain (Closed Lost,
Verbally Confirmed or Will Churn renewals), which uses
`r pct(certain_fy / plan_fy)` of the annual plan before any at-risk renewal is lost.

**Quarter by quarter.** `r best_q` has the best chance of landing at or under plan
(`r pct(stats[best_q, "Chance at or under plan"])`); `r worst_q` the weakest
(`r pct(stats[worst_q, "Chance at or under plan"])`).

```{r fy-table}
tab <- stats %>%
  transmute(Period, Plan = usd(Plan), `Expected (mean)` = usd(Expected),
            `Best case (P25)` = usd(P25), `Most likely (P50)` = usd(P50), `Worst case (P75)` = usd(P75),
            `Chance at or under plan` = pct(`Chance at or under plan`))
knitr::kable(tab, format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE, align = c("l", rep("r", 6)))
```

\footnotesize

**Method.** Each renewal is an independent coin flip: Closed Lost, Verbally
Confirmed and Will Churn always churn; Expected to Churn churns with probability
`r p[1]`; At Risk Renewal with probability `r p[2]`; Expecting to Renew and Closed Won
are not modelled. Q1 and Q2 come from Salesforce renewals in the
`r snap_date` snapshot (certain and expected churn valued at
`r params$sf_amount_field`, at-risk at Amount); Q3 and Q4 use the hand-entered amounts
from `scripts/FY28_churn_forecast_model.R`. The year is the sum of the four quarters in each
run. Plan figures are `load_constants()$churn_plan`.

\normalsize

```{r quarter-helpers}
quarter_intro <- function(q) {
  s <- stats[q, ]; x <- fc[[q]]
  b <- x$table %>% group_by(Bucket) %>% summarise(n = n(), v = sum(`Modelled $`), .groups = "drop")
  g <- function(k) { r <- b[b$Bucket == k, ]; if (nrow(r)) sprintf("%d (%s)", r$n, usdk(r$v)) else "none" }
  knitr::asis_output(sprintf(
    "**%s chance of landing at or under the %s plan.** Best case (P25) %s, most likely (P50) %s, worst case (P75) %s; expected %s.\n\nInputs (%s): certain churn %s, expected to churn %s, at risk %s.\n\n",
    pct(s$`Chance at or under plan`), usd(s$Plan), usd(s$P25), usd(s$P50), usd(s$P75), usd(s$Expected),
    x$source, g("Certain churn"), g("Expected to churn"), g("At risk")))
}
show_png <- function(path, q, param) {
  if (!nzchar(path)) {
    return(knitr::asis_output(sprintf(
      "> *Renewal ratings PNG for %s goes here. Set `%s` in the YAML header at the top of this file.*\n\n",
      q, param)))
  }
  full <- if (file.exists(path)) path else file.path(root, path)
  if (!file.exists(full)) {
    return(knitr::asis_output(sprintf("> *PNG not found: `%s` (set in `%s`).*\n\n", path, param)))
  }
  knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath(full), rel_path = FALSE)
}
renewal_table <- function(q) {
  t <- fc[[q]]$table %>%
    arrange(factor(Bucket, c("Certain churn", "Expected to churn", "At risk", "Not modelled")), desc(Amount)) %>%
    mutate(Amount = usd(Amount), `Modelled $` = usd(`Modelled $`),
           `Chance of churn` = case_when(Bucket == "Certain churn" ~ "100%",
                                         Bucket == "Expected to churn" ~ pct(p[1]),
                                         Bucket == "At risk" ~ pct(p[2]), TRUE ~ "—"))
  if (all(is.na(t$Account))) t$Account <- NULL
  names(t) <- sub("$", "\\$", names(t), fixed = TRUE)
  knitr::kable(t, format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE,
               align = ifelse(names(t) %in% c("Amount", "Modelled \\$", "Chance of churn"), "r", "l"))
}
```

# Churn distribution

## FY28 total churn

```{r dist-fy, fig.height = 4.2}
lines <- data.frame(
  x     = c(plan_fy, fy$P25, fy$P50, fy$P75),
  what  = c("Plan", "P25 best case", "P50 most likely", "P75 worst case"),
  label = c(paste0("Plan ", .usdk(plan_fy), " (", pct(fy[["Chance at or under plan"]]), " at or under)"),
            paste("P25 best case", .usdk(fy$P25)), paste("P50 most likely", .usdk(fy$P50)),
            paste("P75 worst case", .usdk(fy$P75))),
  y     = c(1.00, 0.92, 0.84, 0.76))
cols <- c("Plan" = "#111111", "P25 best case" = "#16A34A", "P50 most likely" = "#B45309", "P75 worst case" = "#DC2626")
h <- ggplot(data.frame(x = sims_fy), aes(x)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "#9CA3AF", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2)
ymax <- max(ggplot_build(h)$data[[1]]$count)
h +
  geom_vline(data = lines, aes(xintercept = x, colour = what, linetype = what), linewidth = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = lines, aes(x = x, y = y * ymax * 1.08, label = paste0(" ", label), colour = what),
            hjust = 0, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Plan" = "solid", "P25 best case" = "dashed",
                                   "P50 most likely" = "dashed", "P75 worst case" = "dashed")) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = axis_usd) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = "Simulated FY28 churn", y = "Simulated years")
```

## Cumulative distribution by quarter

The diamond on each line is that quarter's plan: its height is the chance of
landing at or under plan.

```{r dist-ecdf}
plan_pts <- data.frame(Quarter = quarters, Plan = unname(plan),
                       Pct = sapply(quarters, function(q) mean(sims[[q]] <= plan[[q]])))
ecdf_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(quarters, function(q) {
  x <- sort(sims[[q]]); data.frame(Quarter = q, Value = x, Percentile = seq_along(x) / length(x))
}))
ggplot(ecdf_df, aes(Value, Percentile, colour = Quarter)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = plan_pts, aes(Plan, Pct, fill = Quarter), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             shape = 23, size = 3.2, colour = "#111111", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = plan_pts, aes(Plan, Pct, label = paste0("  plan: ", pct(Pct))), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 0, size = 2.8, colour = "#111111") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = axis_usd) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Simulated quarterly churn", y = "Cumulative probability", colour = NULL)
```

## Spread by quarter against plan

```{r dist-box}
long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(quarters, function(q) data.frame(Quarter = q, Churn = sims[[q]])))
p50  <- data.frame(Quarter = quarters, P50 = stats[quarters, "P50"])
ggplot(long, aes(Quarter, Churn)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#E5E7EB", colour = "#6B7280", outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.55) +
  geom_errorbar(data = p50, aes(x = Quarter, ymin = P50, ymax = P50, colour = "P50 most likely"),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, width = 0.6, linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = plan_pts, aes(Quarter, Plan, shape = "Plan"), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             size = 3.5, fill = "#111111") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("P50 most likely" = "#F59E0B"), name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Plan" = 23), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = axis_usd) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Simulated churn")
```

Boxes span P25 to P75 of the simulated runs; whiskers reach 1.5 times that range.

## Chance of landing at or under plan

```{r dist-prob, fig.height = 3.4}
pp <- stats %>% mutate(Period = factor(Period, levels = c(quarters, "FY28")),
                       ok = `Chance at or under plan` >= .5)
ggplot(pp, aes(Period, `Chance at or under plan`, fill = ok)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = pct(`Chance at or under plan`)), vjust = -0.4, size = 3.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dotted", colour = "#9CA3AF") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#16A34A", `FALSE` = "#DC2626")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1.1), breaks = seq(0, 1, .25)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Chance at or under plan")
```
